title: feat(ridk8): ridge-slide same-k holds at k=8: t=20 vs t=28
science: rho3 at k=8 on B_24: t=20 vs 28, 1200>784. Also machine-asserts hugk1-pair-kept (the k=1 pair stays 3 vs 5 under rho3) and ridge-not-all-body (rho3 does NOT tax a 3->3 hop with fewer than two unit coords), i.e. the two properties that separate rho3 from eps and from beta.
